THE FULL LENGTH COULD NOT BE DETERMINED DUE TO THE ANOMALY EXTENDING BEYOND THE BOUNDS OF THE IMAGE.

Nearest City: Dallas, TX
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: AMMONIUM BIFLUORIDE
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: VOUGHT AIRCRAFT INDUSTRIES
Skytruth Analysis
WHILE TRANSFERRING CHEMICALS FROM A PROCESS LINE VIA A VACUUM TRUCK, A VALVE LEAKED ON THE TRUCK, RESULTING IN A RELEASE OF THE CHEMICAL. THE PRODUCT IS A MIXTURE OF SULFURIC ACID, FERRIC SULFATE, AND AMMONIUM BIFLUORIDE. THE TOTAL QUANTITY RELEASED WAS 500 GALLONS. DURING THE CLEANUP EVOLUTION, A STORM WASHED ALL 500 GALLONS INTO A STORM DRAIN SYSTEM, ALONG WITH 3.2 MILLION GALLONS OF STORM WATER. THE OUTFALL BETWEEN THE STORM WATER SYSTEM AND NATURAL WATERWAYS IS PERMITTED UNDER TPDES PERMIT #WQ0004519000. THE TANKER TRUCK IS OWNED AND OPERATED BY A THIRD PARTY. THE PROPERTY IS OWNED BY THE U.S. NAVY.

CLAIR RIVER. • SUNCOR REPORTED THE MATERIAL TO BE APPROXIMATELY 1,320 GALLONS OF CRUDE OIL AND ENACTED THEIR FACILITY RESPONSE PLAN. • THE SOURCE WAS ISOLATED AND SECURED. • SUNCOR DEPLOYED BOOM AROUND THE PRODUCT. • SECTOR DETROIT POLLUTION RESPONDERS VERIFIED THE VOLUME OF PRODUCT. • AN OVERFLIGHT FROM USCG AIR STATION DETROIT WILL BE CONDUCTED FOR PHOTO DOCUMENTATION. • SARNIA VESSEL TRAFFIC SERVICE (CANADA) DID NOT ALTER THE FLOW OF TRAFFIC ON THE RIVER, AND THERE IS NO REQUEST FOR FURTHER COAST GUARD ASSISTANCE. • THE WATERWAY IS STILL OPEN TO VESSEL TRAFFIC. • THE CIC PROCESS WAS STOOD DOWN WITH CONCURRENCE FROM BOTH AREA COMMAND CENTERS.
